VMware-AIops

<a id="readme-overview"></a>

Turn VM lifecycle requests into explicit, auditable operations for vCenter and ESXi.

English · 简体中文

Community-maintained · MIT · Not an official VMware/Broadcom product.

![24-second illustrative investigation demo](https://github.com/vmware-skills/marketplace/releases/download/demos-2026-11-13-operations/vmware-skills-en.mp4)

Synthetic-data GIF; video includes redacted historical screenshots. Download the AI-narrated family introduction (~3 min)

<a id="readme-capabilities-and-workflows"></a>

Why use it?

  • Deploy and manage VMs, snapshots and guest tasks.
  • Preview destructive actions and inspect task results.
  • Use dedicated companion modules for focused investigations.

<a id="readme-quick-start"></a>

Get started

Install the published CLI and inspect its commands:


uv tool install vmware-aiops==2.5.0

vmware-aiops --help

Requires uv and Python >=3.10. Configure targets and credentials locally before remote queries. Setup guide.

For agent-host installation, use the setup guide and Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cline and local-model examples.

Choose a model with the shared model-fit workflow: compare the same tasks, review quality and safety, then select the smallest tested passing configuration per task group; this is not a production guarantee.

<a id="readme-safety-and-audit"></a>

Know the boundaries

Includes sensitive infrastructure writes, guest execution and file transfers. Account permissions, local Policy and host-path boundaries apply; confirmation is not independent human approval.
